schema_version: 1
layers:
  domain: internal/domain
  use_cases: internal/usecase
  inbound_http: internal/transport/http
  inbound_message: internal/transport/message/nats
  outbound_postgres: internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres
  outbound_events: internal/infrastructure/messaging/nats
  outbound_services:
    - internal/infrastructure/http/student
    - internal/infrastructure/http/dialog
    - internal/infrastructure/http/aiprompt
    - internal/infrastructure/http/course
    - internal/infrastructure/http/practice
    - internal/infrastructure/http/learningplanner
    - internal/infrastructure/http/statistic
    - internal/infrastructure/http/telegram
  composition_root: cmd/ms-go-teacher-agent/main.go
invariants:
  - diagnostic completion only ensures Placement and reads durable owner state; initial planning requires an explicit action and never runs automatically on completion or reload
  - diagnostic presentation owns no learner state; active path claims require authoritative Student confirmation and retryability is true only for ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED
  - internal/transport direct children are fail-closed to http, message, cli, websocket, and common
  - internal/transport/http direct children are fail-closed to api, admin, private, and provider-signed integrations
  - transport is inbound-only; concrete outbound HTTP clients are owned by infrastructure and forbidden under transport and adapters
  - API, admin, and private routers import only handlers owned by their contour
  - infrastructure is outbound-only and fail-closed to persistence/postgres, messaging/nats, http/student, http/course, http/practice, http/dialog, http/aiprompt, http/learningplanner, http/statistic, and http/telegram
  - internal/adapters is forbidden and must be absent
  - domain and usecase do not import transport, infrastructure, or framework implementations
  - the composition root independently wires all HTTP contours and outbound implementations
  - handlers parse and serialize; use cases own behavior; repositories own persistence
  - API and admin authentication is composed at the root; each route applies its own role policy
  - private routes are unversioned under /internal and require the exact shared token
  - Telegram webhook ingress is isolated under integrations and requires the exact provider secret; it never trusts gateway actor headers
  - PersonalTeacher never contains student mastery, path, session, attempts, raw events, code, or dialog history
  - every PersonalTeacher has exactly one independently versioned TeacherSoul bound to the same student_id; soul contains no learning state or conversation history
  - database-derived events are committed through the transactional outbox and delivered at least once
  - consumers deduplicate stable event_id through an inbox or processed-event ledger
  - learning_action.closed is an inbound trigger only; teacher-agent never imports its objective result
  - task decisions and assistance correlate by the distinct learning_action_id
  - knowledge-tree data and course content are not copied into this service
  - full lesson content is transient verification input only; model variables receive only the exact bounded verified overview or selected fragment
  - StudentContext is an in-memory bounded snapshot built from Student for general/lesson/Course actions and directly from Practice plus Student exact mastery for practice_task/project
  - Dialog request context is bounded to the exact source plus at most 49 prior messages and is never persisted by teacher-agent
  - public teacher-dialog provisioning derives student identity from trusted headers and validates Dialog's canonical binding before returning it
  - dialog.teacher.requested is acknowledged only after durable teacher_dialog_job ownership or verified duplicate acceptance
  - generated teacher response text is private pending-delivery state and is cleared after verified idempotent Dialog append
  - source channel is durable request metadata; Telegram delivery is separately queued only after canonical Dialog append and never causes regeneration
  - deterministic teacher-dialog policy selects the hint level before confidential model execution and never permits a complete solution
  - Practice's immutable assistance policy is an upper bound on Teacher policy; every delivered Practice response records its assistance usage before Dialog append
  - practice_task requests may add only Practice's strict bounded teacher-validation-explanation.v1 projection; exact student, instance, frozen revision, and learning-action identities must match before prompt use
  - Practice validation explanations are optional advisory prompt context and never change official validation, task status, evidence, mastery, or assistance policy
  - TeacherOrchestrator selects deterministic PedagogyMethod implementations through a composition-root registry, never a hard-coded method switch
  - teaching plans and decisions record method code, method version, and a bounded method-neutral stage
  - AI Prompt calls use teacher.response.v1 with the source event_id as the stable idempotency key and never persist prompt context or raw provider output
  - v1 lesson responses require the existing exact current Course revision; v2 responses require exact Student frozen assignment owner/path/item/course/lesson/revision/digest and substring; full content is never copied to model variables
  - Teacher submits learning intent to Learning Planner and never reads Course curriculum, traverses target prerequisites, computes mastery gaps, generates courses, or writes Student paths
  - product-aware onboarding sends Learning Planner only an exact Student state reference; deterministic Teacher policy owns user-visible product claims and never invokes planning/finalization
  - terminal onboarding closes the exact active interaction durably; reserved or action-claimed prompts are never stolen and stale new actions have no Dialog or Student effect
  - S8 READY admission is a durable state-fenced Teacher command to Learning Planner; ACCEPTED is historical non-executable admission, not an active-path reservation or proof that content exists
  - the onboarding handoff ledger stores bounded identities and checkpoints only; it never stores Student profile/model text/graph payload and never invokes course, path, lesson, NBA, Practice, or Student mutation
  - Teacher-originated course.plan outcomes are accepted through an idempotent inbox before bounded Dialog delivery; other planning sources have no Teacher side effects
  - Next Best Action consumes Student authoritative student-next-action.v1 without local action selection or progress mutation; explicit next-step Dialog questions explain owner decisions without model calls
cross_service_contracts:
  - teacher.decision.recorded is an audit event and does not transfer student-state ownership
  - teacher.assistance.observed contains teacher-owned facts only; ms-go-student remains mastery authority
  - learning targets are provider-neutral references; Course owns regular-task projections and the reusable practice catalog owns milestone projections
  - targetless action closures are recorded inbox-only and never generate inferred observations
  - Course task targets come from Student's frozen LearningAction; Practice task targets and public Step context come from the exact frozen Practice instance; teacher never trusts caller targets
  - Validation explanations come only through Practice's student-scoped safe projection; Teacher never reads Validation directly or receives raw stages, evidence, test output, code snapshots, private selectors, review, or solutions
  - Student context construction fails closed when its authoritative owner is unavailable or response identity/order/count is inconsistent
  - Dialog trigger and HTTP snapshots fail closed on unknown fields, unsupported versions, identity drift, or educational-context drift
